016d57ec.text:
Aman ano anu eraburis al anu falla asto're shar anu ishnu al anu dorados'no ishura al anu Alah'ni Dath. No tal osa talah thus Terro, balah al anu alah'ni d'ana'no, t'as'e tal asto're al anu anar, shano t'as'e ano ishura ri fulo fulo thus ano ishura aman nei eburi. Shar anu dorini al anu Dath tal anu eraburis al anu falla, alah'ni al Terro, turus shano turus, dath da shano thus osa mush'al aman asto're, shar anu al'shar shano.

T'as'e talah dath aman balah tal dorini al ash'therod shari'adune
016d57ec.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

0be732f1.text:
Some fear our kind more than dragons. Some envy us more than the most skilled blacksmiths. Some praise our strength in battle. Others revel in our faith. Some are just jealous that we can drink them under the table! But know this, $c, you are among the most elite protectors in all of Azeroth. The Holy Light gives us strength as much as we strengthen it.

I would tell you more when you've gotten acquainted with the land some. Find me inside Anvilmar above the Valley.

-Bromos Grummner, $C Trainer
0be732f1.title: Consecrated Rune

1a152bba.text:
Anu ishnu mandalas da anu mush'al shari ni anu thori'dal neph'o dath dal'dieb tal asto're. Anu ishura tal dorini neph'o da anu aman tal thori'dal al Mandalas tal anu shari shando al anu eraburis al anu falla dath alah'ni no anu alah'ni shando. Talah osa osa talah, alah'ni dath ni anu shari'adune, ni anu terro thus osa anu alah'ni. Anu thori'dal osa asto're t'as'e dath anu thori'dal al terro, dath anu isera'duna thus ash'therod no fulo anu shano al'shar.

Mush'al t'as'e mush'al. Shando t'as'e
1a152bba.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

2677e79a.text:
Lady Cassandra Valor, Loving mother and wife

Not much is known about Cassandra other than her love for her family. She nurtured brave children and a powerful husband, leading some to muse that the family's greatness was all her doing. A flattery she would always decline with grace.

If she is remembered for nothing else, let it be known that everything she did was for her family.
2677e79a.title: Memories of Valor

3728af3c.text:
Ira Valor, Forest Stalker

When Ira's father grew ill, she took it upon herself to gather food and supplies from the nearby forests. While resources were not in short supply, you were as likely to find food as you were to become it.

Over the years, she adapted to the forests, preferring to spend her time within the dark woods rather than in Raven Hill. Travelers who got lost in the trees would tell stories of a shadow seemingly opening the way for them back to the road. There was no confirmations of who it was, but rumors spread quickly.

It's said that Ira is still in the woods offering a guiding hand to those who fall prey to the beasts within.
3728af3c.title: Memories of Valor

5f2f8c31.text:
Long had the children of the stars dwelled upon the banks of the shimmering waters of the Eternal Well. To all was known that Elune, light of the eternal twilight, aspect and goddess of the moon, dwelt within its waters at such time that she rested from her works. Upon the shores of the Well did the children of the stars, favored of Elune, build their homes, even as their gaze was trained ever skyward, into the moonlit night.

Though there were many towns and places of habitation constructed
5f2f8c31.title: The Lay of Ameth'Aran

9dd6367a.text:
The earth trembled as the ancient trees in the enchanted forest were uprooted and toppled. The groves and glades tended by the sons and daughters of Cenarius and the stone towers of the children of the stars were brought to the rolling ground. There was our queen, radiant even in the desperation, in the chaos that was the battles. The enchanted sky changed colors with the discharge of magic, with the explosions that threatened to tear the world asunder.

Brother fought brother. Chosen fought
9dd6367a.title: The Fall of Ameth'Aran

b0897304.text:
Merrick Valor, Watcher of Darkshire

Merrick was the youngest son of the Valor family. As he witnessed the corruption coming to his homeland, he chose to join The Watch in a desperate bid to protect his loved ones.

While he was the most inexperienced member of his family, he quickly made a name for himself amongst the ranks of The Watchers. He had a knack for archery, and soon became one of the most staunch defenders of Darkshire.

His personal mission was to keep the roads safe, wary of the ever more hostile creatures coming to the forests.
b0897304.title: Memories of Valor

b38214e6.text:
Lord Grant Valor, Sire of the Valor Family

Lord Grant, may he rest in peace, was the pinnacle of Alliance exceptionalism. A natural leader, his guiding hand helped lead the denizens of Raven Hill to prosperity. When darkness began to creep into the woods, he was the first to rally our people.

There was no more foul a foe than the undead to Lord Grant. He personally patrolled the cemeteries of Duskwood to keep the shambling hordes in check. The day he took a grievous blow from the monsters, everyone in town shared his pain.

With his family's care, he returned to his duties, but there was a lingering malady that seemed to follow him for the rest of his days.
b38214e6.title: Memories of Valor

d557c053.text:
Memories of Valor
A Recount of the Valor Family and Their Service to Raven Hill

There was no greater family in all of the Eastern Kingdoms than the Valor family. Their deeds to the people they swore to protect were nothing short of miracles, and their loss is a loss for all of Raven Hill.

I write this account to set the record straight, detailing the marvels that were Grant, Ira, Silvia, and Merrick. May these writings be a small consolation for how sorry I am for their absence.
d557c053.title: Memories of Valor

ec82091a.text:
Silvia Valor, Raven Hill Guard

Silvia Valor had already been a local hero by the time she was offered to join the Guard. If there was one thing she could not stand to suffer more than anything, it was opportunists who took advantage of those who were struggling.

Bandits, con artists, rabble-rousers, it didn't matter. Silvia put each to the sword for trying to sow chaos in her beloved home. It was only natural she would be put in a position of real authority to act out her vision of justice.

It's said that, until she drew her last breath, she would never abandon the farmsteads and homes of Duskwood. And perhaps not even then.
ec82091a.title: Memories of Valor

10090|0e051c59.name: Belia Thundergranite
10090|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

10118|c6fbc16f.name: Nessa Shadowsong
10118|c6fbc16f.text: The fish off the coast of Teldrassil are quite large and robust.  Rumors say it is the speedy growth of our new world tree that is the cause.

10216|1147bc15.name: Gubber Blump
10216|1147bc15.text: ...pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried...

10219|572db4df.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
10219|572db4df.text: May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.

10276|d6f17c90.name: Rotgath Stonebeard
10276|d6f17c90.text: Aye, I would love ta teach ye a thing or two about smithing. Grab an apron and a hammer and let's see what we can accomplish shall we?

10277|a14963d0.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|a14963d0.text: Ye've got a little skill on ye. Enough to learn ye a few things I wager. Let's see what I can teach ye, shall we?

10277|de38fa19.name: Groum Stonebeard
10277|de38fa19.text: Ye know more than I do, that's a certainty. Tell ye what though, go talk with me da'. He'll want ye ta prove yerself, but he is a fine teacher indeed. His name's Rotgath, and ye'll find him near the anvils workin steel for ol' Bengus.

1077|75241b9c.name: Prospector Whelgar
1077|75241b9c.text: Oh my, this is quite historical.  A monumental find.  But these wretched beasts!  Merrin seems to be handling the situation quite well.  Now if I could just piece together this complicated puzzle. . . .

10930|a665cdb8.name: Dargh Trueaim
10930|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

11028|aa37b039.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|aa37b039.text: Well... I hate to admit it, but my sister's the one you'll have to talk to if you want to continue training. I don't know as much as she does... yet! She's standing over by the rocket car.

11028|ea44f66d.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|ea44f66d.text: I heard the new Henweigh 6000 will be rolling off the assembly line soon. I can barely contain my excitement!

11029|28ea6aca.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|28ea6aca.text: You'll need to prove your worthiness before I go giving away my secrets! I've got just the test for you...

11029|afb5ab05.name: Trixie Quikswitch
11029|afb5ab05.text: Don't tell anyone else I said this, but even I don't know everything! If you want to keep learning, you should talk to the owner of the shop, Springspindle Fizzlegear.

11068|327fd53e.name: Betty Quin
11068|327fd53e.text: I'm afraid I have nothing to teach to someone with your experience. But you haven't reached the end of the road yet. Speak to Lucan Cordell, behind the counter there. He'll guide you through the next phase of your journey.

11072|15d6b2ff.name: Kitta Firewind
11072|15d6b2ff.text: Your skills are truly becoming extraordinary. Now, let us continue your training...

11072|89c37a9a.name: Kitta Firewind
11072|89c37a9a.text: You have nearly reached the pinnacle of your training. To become the greatest enchanter you can possibly be, you have one more instructor to seek out. Her name is Annora, and you may find her in Uldaman.

11081|68d4b95d.name: Faldron
11081|68d4b95d.text: If you are here for further training, you have overestimated my abilities. Have a word with Telonis over there; he can help you.

11081|cb7eee8e.name: Faldron
11081|cb7eee8e.text: Many animals lost their lives so that we could gain these materials. Do not take their sacrifice lightly, $N. Handle the leather with the respect it deserves.

11083|9dd7b921.name: Darianna
11083|9dd7b921.text: Oh, I'm sorry, but you know more about leather than I do at this point. Talk to Faldron over there if you wish to learn more.

11096|904d1c22.name: Randal Worth
11096|904d1c22.text: There's nothing I can teach you, other than maybe a better eye for color and detail. Talk to Simon Tanner over there; he knows a lot of advanced techniques for working with leather.

1154|3696a22b.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|3696a22b.text:
Though I hate to admit it, the bear did get the better of me. My oh my, that's one big ol' bear!

Nonetheless, if you can take that bear down, it'd be a feat to be proud of! It gave more than a few of our best hunters some trouble.

<He claps you on the back.>

Best the bear and we'll accept you as a regular member of the Farstrider Lodge.

1154|b7c42d9a.name: Marek Ironheart
1154|b7c42d9a.text:
Here at the Farstrider lodge, we prize hunting skills above all else. Wish to gain my approval? You'll have to earn it.

You look up to the challenge, lad!

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

11866|f3b1497b.name: Ilyenia Moonfire
11866|f3b1497b.text: The grace with which I fight is not something I can teach you, but I can teach you the use of various weapons.

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

1232|2583dfa7.name: Azar Stronghammer
1232|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

1239|c86281a7.name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
1239|c86281a7.text: If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...

1241|4a926ca6.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|4a926ca6.text: Good day to ye lad. Can I be of service?

1241|d7387f9e.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|d7387f9e.text: Ye learn fast lad, much faster than I can keep up with. If ye want ta continue yer training, I suggest ye see my teacher. His name's Rotgath, Rotgath Stonebeard and ye'll find him in Ironforge at The Great Forge.

1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1244|e492be56.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|e492be56.text:
<Rethiel takes the Rotheap Innards from you.>

It is worse than I thought. The dark presence deep beneath us seethes with a malevolence that has seeped into the very fibers of life within the wetlands.

For now, I fear all we can do is combat its symptoms. Provide relief to the land and those who rely on it where we can.

Meanwhile, we must continue to look for the source. It roils... whispers just under the veil of the sounds of night.

Take this, as a token of my gratitude. May it help you further combat this madness.

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1252|83b3b21e.name: Senir Whitebeard
1252|83b3b21e.text: Greetings and salutations to you, good $r. P'rhaps you'd like to share a drink with me, help fight off the chill of the wind? Come, I've more than enough to share.

12577|c5ceacbe.name: Jarrodenus
12577|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1257|ed056522.name: Keldric Boucher
1257|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1265|a0959aba.name: Rudra Amberstill
1265|a0959aba.text: Welcome to the Amberstill Corral.  If you're interested in purchasing a mount, my husband Veron will be more than happy to help you choose just the right beast.  If you're looking for adventure, well we sure could use some help around here. . .

1285|ed056522.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1285|fe52f4ea.name: Thurman Mullby
1285|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1286|ed056522.name: Edna Mullby
1286|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1286|fe52f4ea.name: Edna Mullby
1286|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1292|ec1a6e0b.name: Maris Granger
1292|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

1297|ed056522.name: Lina Stover
1297|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1297|fe52f4ea.name: Lina Stover
1297|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1298|fe52f4ea.name: Frederick Stover
1298|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

12997|6ce695f2.name: Monty
12997|6ce695f2.text: Monty be me name an' rats be me game.

13018|0a2f0661.name: Nipsy
13018|0a2f0661.text: You'll find no finer rat kabob this side of Khaz Modan!

1305|9f005af4.name: Jarel Moor
1305|9f005af4.text: Take my advice, don't sit close to the shadows.

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1317|f472d1d3.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|f472d1d3.text: A true professional know his limitations, and I'm not ashamed to admit that your skills exceed mine. I want you to pay a visit to Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora. She is well-renowned, and with good reason.

1318|23d8b931.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1340|76d04af9.name: Mountaineer Kadrell
1340|76d04af9.text:
Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!

Thelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.

1343|5751dde2.name: Mountaineer Stormpike
1343|5751dde2.text:
Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!

No time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...

1346|ddcdeb42.name: Georgio Bolero
1346|ddcdeb42.text: Good! I can tell that my efforts will not be wasted!

1351|a96dc031.name: Brother Cassius
1351|a96dc031.text: May the light guide your path and aid you in your journies. If you need any assistance browsing, I will be right over here.

1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

14450|d3e1a5a0.name: Orphan Matron Nightingale
14450|d3e1a5a0.text:
There are costs with war, $c... ones often overlooked.  Those costs are the orphans - children who have lost their parents to the far-too-numerous conflicts that rage across Azeroth.  Those children who have no one else to turn to often come here to live until they are old enough to fend for themselves.

One week out of the year during the Spring, the Alliance takes time to give something back to these innocents.  This time is called Children's Week.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1646|1d2a2e75.name: Baros Alexston
1646|1d2a2e75.text: Greetings, I am Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind.

1681|d4740e3c.name: Brock Stoneseeker
1681|d4740e3c.text: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.

1699|0c543544.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1699|b48f927f.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1702|ff623593.name: Bronk Guzzlegear
1702|ff623593.text: I would train ye if I could, but ye need the services of someone a bit more... what's the word? Brainy! Look for Trixie Quickswitch in Ironforge. Tell 'er Bronk sent ye!

1719|bf4c7bb7.name: Warden Thelwater
1719|bf4c7bb7.text: Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!

2057|f6158e52.name: Huldar
2057|f6158e52.text:
Delivering these barrels to the excavation site is hard work, but there are so many depending on us to get the blast powder there.

We must do what we can against the Dark Irons!

2094|28b1f157.name: James Halloran
2094|28b1f157.text: Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

214954|6cf4abd2.name: Rix Xizzix
214954|6cf4abd2.text:
Welcome to the Xizzix Asset Recovery Service! If you lost it, we probably found it! 

Check my stock to see if we've recovered anything that you might have carelessly discarded and have since decided you just can't live without.

2277|985afd1f.name: Loremaster Dibbs
2277|985afd1f.text: Hello, $N! What can I do for you?

227853|066d9580.name: Pix Xizzix
227853|066d9580.text: Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

2367|c2467ddc.name: Donald Rabonne
2367|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

246848|93d3f9d1.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|93d3f9d1.text: Greetings, $N. Welcome to the kingdom of Dalaran.  There are restrictions in place while the city remains under construction. If you have important matters that must be presented to the Kirin Tor, you may speak with Arcanist Ginsberg in the overlook to the east.

246848|ae06472b.name: Kirin Tor Guard
246848|ae06472b.text:
It is still under construction and only a short walk up the northeast road. The Alterac mountains have brought unneeded attention from some wild creatures and our recent interest in Silverpine Forest has kept our patrols quite busy.

Some small rumors have even spread about a juvenile drake soaring over the mountains with a full eye.

247264|a8fa316f.name: Emissary Jacques
247264|a8fa316f.text:
Hail and well met, traveler.

I wish my arrival was met with good tidings but the realm of Dalaran is in need of aid from the kingdoms of the Alliance.

251374|4d87d665.name: Windshaper Boro
251374|4d87d665.text:
The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.

If you are initiated in the ways of the shaman, I can help you grasp them.

251507|af6809a8.name: Josephine Carson
251507|af6809a8.text: Greetings, $c. I can teach you skills and techniques.

252380|82211412.name: Othesia Evengale
252380|82211412.text: Welcome to my shop; it's good to see another Tailor here in Valanaar. Are you here for a lesson perhaps?

253092|e0247c5d.name: Alba Fairmoon
253092|e0247c5d.text:
I am told the farms of Westfall once supplied a bounty of crops for Stormwind. But now, the soil is barren and most of the farmers have fled.

On behalf of Darnassus I would like to offer my aid in replenishing this land. Will you assist me?

256306|f652f067.name: Arcanist Laurain
256306|f652f067.text:
Welcome to Dalaran, $c. 

Please pay no mind to some of the construction that is still underway. Oh, and should you encounter a rogue arcane anomaly, demon, or other malign entity, please feel free to seek assistance from the nearest member of the Kirin Tor before fleeing--um... proceeding--to the nearest exit in an orderly fashion!

<Arcanist Laurain laughs nervously.>

Thank you for visiting!

256390|6a190ff9.name: Marcy Baker
256390|6a190ff9.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

256735|8db10840.name: Mivin Shadowweave
256735|8db10840.text: <Mivin gestures toward his wares and back at you again with a smile, but says nothing.>

258043|c6710551.name: Norric Lochthane
258043|c6710551.text: Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.

258572|cad23935.name: Dani'ill
258572|cad23935.text: Many of the supplies that tradesmen need can be found in the world. For those that cannot, I provide a limited selection for fair price.

258930|0e051c59.name: Isaac Chan
258930|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

261|a2b799cb.name: Guard Thomas
261|a2b799cb.text: Hello, citizen.  You look like a man with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?

264936|6ba63b30.name: Earthseer Farsen
264936|6ba63b30.text: On a clear day, you can even see Blackrock Mountain from here. It's both beautiful and terrifying at the same time.

264|b3b21323.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
264|b3b21323.text: At ease, $C.  If you are just passing though I suggest you stick to the roads and only travel by day. If your business is here in Darkshire, consider lending your abilities to The Night Watch.  Our skill is unquestionable but our numbers are small.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

272|c8dcec52.name: Chef Grual
272|c8dcec52.text: Hello, hello!  Welcome to my kitchen, sir!  This is where all of the Scarlet Raven Tavern's finest delicacies are made.  Ah, just smell the wonderful aroma!

273|1299e7cb.name: Tavernkeep Smitts
273|1299e7cb.text: Keep the door closed, $C.  Never know when the Dark Riders will be passing through again.

275212|8443298b.name: Teller Hanners
275212|8443298b.text: I'm afraid we're not up and running just yet. Please do check back later!

275243|a3886d45.name: Teller Gee
275243|a3886d45.text: Apologies, sir. The bank isn't open yet. Please come back later, if you don't mind.

276170|e50e47b5.name: Belanaa Windveil
276170|e50e47b5.text: I am Belanaa Windveil and I am an agent of the High Order here on Azeroth. If you'd like to make a donation of cloth to our organization, we would be most grateful.

277|fe52f4ea.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

2786|c9907ea0.name: Gerrig Bonegrip
2786|c9907ea0.text:
Welcome to Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, $c.  You may look, but do not touch.

Some of the knowledge here is not meant for the...uninitiated.

278|a87776c0.name: Sara Timberlain
278|a87776c0.text: Hello, good sir.  Have a seat, and a meal if you're hungry.  Don't fret if I look busy with my needlework - I'm listening to you...

2834|837eac47.name: Myizz Luckycatch
2834|837eac47.text: You will need to find Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh to get any better than you are currently.

2859|2cc67a59.name: Gyll
2859|2cc67a59.text: Fastest gryphons this side of Aerie Peak. Want to take a ride?

2879|0e051c59.name: Karrina Mekenda
2879|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

29049|21fc3122.name: Arille Azuregaze
29049|21fc3122.text: You look like a $c who could use a drink and an ear.

2913|5112b624.name: Archaeologist Hollee
2913|5112b624.text: Who would have guessed the excavation would have uncovered such findings!

2930|cd94cda6.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
2930|cd94cda6.text: Corruption sneaks into nature's grove.  The forest must be protected at all costs.

295|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Farley
295|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

302|994abcf7.name: Blind Mary
302|994abcf7.text: The memory of my beauty makes its loss unbearable!

341|5369247e.name: Foreman Oslow
341|5369247e.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, DANKOS.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

342|98a3cb30.name: Martie Jainrose
342|98a3cb30.text: Hail, DANKOS!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

3518|ed056522.name: Thomas Miller
3518|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3545|0e051c59.name: Claude Erksine
3545|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

3607|c2467ddc.name: Androl Oakhand
3607|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

3616|29aa26bd.name: Onu
3616|29aa26bd.text:
The wind whispers to those who listen...

Do you hear it?

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

3691|3e6c050b.name: Raene Wolfrunner
3691|3e6c050b.text: I know these forests as if they were a part of me... But know that there is still much to be learned from them, and much danger still hidden.

3693|85fc41cc.name: Terenthis
3693|85fc41cc.text:
$N, I've come to find out how rampant the effects of Fel Moss are throughout Darkshore. The corruption of Teldrassil and our surrounding lands really concerns the druids of the Cenarian Circle, and all Night elves.

It is my goal to find out why this has happened and to put an end to it.

3702|5ae56d71.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
3702|5ae56d71.text: Hello $r, it is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

415|fca64b70.name: Verner Osgood
415|fca64b70.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

4200|c2e88775.name: Laird
4200|c2e88775.text: Although the coast of Darkshore is more dangerous than that of Teldrassil, many fishers find profit here.

4210|0c543544.name: Alegorn
4210|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4211|33af2c00.name: Dannelor
4211|33af2c00.text: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.

4212|f099e750.name: Telonis
4212|f099e750.text: Do not try to force your will upon the leather. Rather, let its natural tendencies dictate what form and function it will take. This is not a battle to be won. Work with the leather, not against it.

4256|d1bed30c.name: Golnir Bouldertoe
4256|d1bed30c.text: If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a $r!

4267|c5ceacbe.name: Daelyshia
4267|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4319|c5ceacbe.name: Thyssiana
4319|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4407|c5ceacbe.name: Teloren
4407|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4452|a84fd61d.name: Kravel Koalbeard
4452|a84fd61d.text:
Come a little closer.  We have important matters to discuss, you and I.

And some of them we don't want everyone to hear...

4454|81f8fb9f.name: Fizzle Brassbolts
4454|81f8fb9f.text: Aha!  Did you see that!  I think this new auto-spanner is going to do just the trick for my new influx manifold design.

464|8234ebcf.name: Guard Parker
464|8234ebcf.text: Hail, $C.  Ill times these are, my friend, for our town is besieged!  The Blackrock Orcs attack from Stonewatch Keep, the Shadowhides loom over the Tower of Ilgalar, and the Redridge Gnoll Pack gathers strength.  I hope you're not here for a holiday...

491|02f3f1d4.name: Quartermaster Lewis
491|02f3f1d4.text: I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.

5111|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Firebrew
5111|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

5117|a665cdb8.name: Regnus Thundergranite
5117|a665cdb8.text: Wot kin I do fer ye?

5127|dd957ca2.name: Fimble Finespindle
5127|dd957ca2.text: Your skills are coming along nicely. Soon you'll be running a leather shop of your own. I'll be glad for the help, $N. My hands are only so fast, you know? There's so much work to do!

5149|837f02f9.name: Brandur Ironhammer
5149|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

514|783731be.name: Smith Argus
514|783731be.text: I don't admit this lightly, but you are a far better smith than I am. If you want to learn more than my meager teachings then I suggest you seek out a $R named Therum Deepforge in Stormwind. You will find him in the Dwarven District.

514|aa4da6d8.name: Smith Argus
514|aa4da6d8.text: If you'd like to learn how to blacksmith your own weapons and armor, I'd be happy to help.

5150|c2e96a28.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|c2e96a28.text: The esteemed Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen can train you further.  He can be found in Theramore treating the wounded at the barracks.

5172|86b6c1ef.name: Briarthorn
5172|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5172|8fca8484.name: Briarthorn
5172|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5174|cdf132dc.name: Springspindle Fizzlegear
5174|cdf132dc.text: Excellent, you have proven yourself worthy! Now for the next phase of your instruction...

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5483|877c4b1d.name: Erika Tate
5483|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5493|e332eb6d.name: Arnold Leland
5493|e332eb6d.text: Ah, a fellow Fisherman. Are you perhaps in need of a little training? Maybe I can show you a thing or two?

5494|fe52f4ea.name: Catherine Leland
5494|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

5495|86b6c1ef.name: Ursula Deline
5495|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5495|8fca8484.name: Ursula Deline
5495|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

5502|fb513610.name: Shylamiir
5502|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause, I was in the middle of some important work.

5511|5ca9cced.name: Therum Deepforge
5511|5ca9cced.text: Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well lad grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.

5512|211be282.name: Kaita Deepforge
5512|211be282.text: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye lad, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

5516|4a5716a3.name: Ulfir Ironbeard
5516|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5520|721fd095.name: Spackle Thornberry
5520|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

5564|30b7493c.name: Simon Tanner
5564|30b7493c.text: Sorry, but you've reached the limit of what I can teach. If you want to learn more, go see Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He's pretty talented, so I hear.

5564|568f7020.name: Simon Tanner
5564|568f7020.text: Hmm, I guess I can take on another student. Well, don't just stand there. Tell me what you're looking to learn.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5595|034389cd.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|034389cd.text: Brandur Ironhammer would be the one ye'd want to see.  Ye can find him in the Hall of Mysteries north of the gates of Ironforge.

5595|2d6411c2.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|2d6411c2.text: Fimble Finespindle has a shop set up on the northwest side of The Great Forge.  I wager he could show ye how to make some fine armor.

5595|3804779b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ab5dd850.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ab5dd850.text: Between Bixi and Buliwyf, there ain't many weapons they haven't had the pleasure of slashing or smashing an orc with.  You can find them hanging out at the Timberline Arms weapon shop if ye need some training.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

6031|86adad20.name: Tormus Deepforge
6031|86adad20.text: Some can't stand the heat of the Great Forge, but I think the heat is just right.  And it's the best place to do some serious smithwork.

6179|9f08e434.name: Tiza Battleforge
6179|9f08e434.text: Many tests await a $c of the Light, DANKOS. Be assured, our paths will cross many times in the future if you remain passionate and hold to those virtues that we praise.

6251|86b6c1ef.name: Strahad Farsan
6251|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

6266|7023447d.name: Menara Voidrender
6266|7023447d.text:
Kar Aman, $N. You look to be a strong $c--you would do well to mind yourself in this area. Touching things you know nothing about, or showing disrespect to your elders is just cause for punishment.

You may not respect me or my companions, but you will learn to respect our power if you prove foolish enough.

Now, enough with the pleasantries, was there something I can do for you?

6300|0b719f6c.name: Elisa Steelhand
6300|0b719f6c.text: How can I help you, friend?

6301|7a1efc7f.name: Gorbold Steelhand
6301|7a1efc7f.text: Greetings lad, if you're looking for the best deals you'll find outside of Ironforge itself, then you've come to the right place.

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

6727|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6735|41276936.name: Innkeeper Saelienne
6735|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

6807|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Skindle
6807|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

6807|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Skindle
6807|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

714|7dd450ba.name: Talin Keeneye
714|7dd450ba.text: Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

716|482d019a.name: Barnil Stonepot
716|482d019a.text: Master Nesingwary has a big hunt ahead of him.  I find helping him prepare for a day in the jungle is much more relaxing than helping him ready for combat.  Although I do miss some of those glorious moments on the battlefield.

7232|2ebb471e.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|2ebb471e.text: What are ye daft? That's not a weapon, that's a dinner knife. I don't train amateurs.

7232|e03d94ba.name: Borgus Steelhand
7232|e03d94ba.text: Can't ye see I'm busy? This had better be good.

727|3660e6cb.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|3660e6cb.text: Och... a $c?  Well lad, ye're in luck!  Azar Stronghammer is back from training and is currently staying at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.

727|3804779b.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

727|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

7766|2849f8e9.name: Tyrion
7766|2849f8e9.text:
You'll have to be patient with me, $N. I've got my Spybot inside working on a very delicate matter. I'll be with ya in a second.

Oh, and do me a favor, try not to let Lescovar see you... we're about to ambush him.

7766|e0ee2668.name: Tyrion
7766|e0ee2668.text: Oh, if I only had a tree branch to hold up in front of me. The guards would never see me then.

786|b76e4f1a.name: Grelin Whitebeard
786|b76e4f1a.text: Greetings, lad. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

8508|15b608c8.name: Gretta Ganter
8508|15b608c8.text: Lookin' to fish? Then you'll need the proper tools.

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8962|0a5060df.name: Hilary
8962|0a5060df.text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

8965|5a359b3f.name: Shawn
8965|5a359b3f.text: Hello there mister... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

9099|738476a6.name: Sraaz
9099|738476a6.text: Having a bad day? Try some cherry pie.

9099|7cf55363.name: Sraaz
9099|7cf55363.text: This pie is so good, would you like some?

926|2583dfa7.name: Bromos Grummner
926|2583dfa7.text: The Light be with ya, $c. How can I help ya?

928|837f02f9.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
928|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

963|f9eae059.name: Deputy Rainer
963|f9eae059.text:
I can't believe the officials in Stormwind, sending the bulk of our army abroad... when our home front is under so much pressure!

With thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.

1645-complete.name: Tiza Battleforge
1645-complete.text:
A pleasure to meet you, $N. I am responsible for putting paladins on the path to greater virtue as they devote themselves to the Light and defend Azeroth from the Scourge and other threats.

The time has come for you to take your first step towards being truly virtuous. If you accept it, I will give you a Book of Divinity. In studying it, you shall learn some about the Light, and what is expected of you. If you understand it, and are capable, then you will succeed in attaining greater abilities.
1645-complete.title: The Tome of Divinity

286-accept.name: Unknown
286-accept.text:
After pulling the barrel free from the muck and opening it, a silvery figurine is found packed in fine straw.  It depicts a young, long-haired Paladin with hammer upraised.

This must be the Menethil Statuette!  You must now return it to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.
286-accept.title: Return the Statuette

308-complete.name: Jarven Thunderbrew
308-complete.text: For me? You're a true hero, $N!
308-complete.title: Distracting Jarven

79008-accept.name: Unknown
79008-accept.text:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008-accept.title: ... and that note you found

79008-complete.name: Unknown
79008-complete.text: As you stumble upon the remnants of yet another charred corpse, your gaze falls upon a message secured to a wooden plank.
79008-complete.title: ... and that note you found

79192-accept.name: Unknown
79192-accept.text: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192-accept.title: Stepping Stones

80001-complete.name: Unknown
80001-complete.text: You put your scout skills to work.
80001-complete.title: Rekindle

80001-progress.name: Unknown
80001-progress.text: An extinguished fire pit. The wood is even dry enough to catch a flame.
80001-progress.title: Rekindle

91899-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91899-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91899-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91899-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91899-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91899-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

91900-complete.name: Marcy Baker
91900-complete.text:
Thank you for your hard work, $N. There has been an uprising in bandits and thieves intercepting trade routes as of late. If you find other crates lying around, please bring them here and we'll handle the rest.

Here is your payment.
91900-complete.title: A Sealed Crate

91900-progress.name: Marcy Baker
91900-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91900-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

92415-accept.name: Unknown
92415-accept.text: <A torn and stained bundle of parchment has barely survived the undead trodden grounds of the graveyard. It mentions a missing child of the Heartweaver family. Perhaps the orphan matron in Stormwind City will know more.>
92415-accept.title: Remember That I Love You

95189-accept.name: Unknown
95189-accept.text: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95189-accept.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95195-accept.name: Unknown
95195-accept.text: <The old Alliance insignia appears to have belonged to a soldier of Lordaeron. These ruins are likely filled with similar medals that living relatives would be grateful to have returned to them.>
95195-accept.title: Bloodied Insignia

95250-complete.name: Unknown
95250-complete.text:
<Truman looks at the head of his former lord in horror and disgust.>

Is this... some kind of joke? Why would you bring me this monstrosity's head?

Get out of my sight! I should have known better than to trust a filthy lesser breed like you. The true sons of Lordaeron will reclaim our home. And when we do we'll finally be free to purge it of beasts like you!
95250-complete.title: Abominable Creatures

95250-progress.name: Unknown
95250-progress.text: You're still alive? Hmmph. Well, what is it? Have you found my lord yet?
95250-progress.title: Abominable Creatures

95646-complete.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-complete.text: It is worse than I feared. An ancient energy stirs. It would be most wise for you to carry word to your eager excavators to stop digging, for their own safety.
95646-complete.title: Horrors in the Highland

95646-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
95646-progress.text: These waters harbor unique life in a brine that gives and takes equally.
95646-progress.title: Horrors in the Highland

95647-complete.name: Unknown
95647-complete.text: I thought we were done for! Something upset the wildlife around here and our excavation team was overwhelmed. Thank you for helping us with those spiders.
95647-complete.title: Lost in the Thicket Things

95772-complete.name: Unknown
95772-complete.text: This dwarf bears a striking resemblance to Dorin Songblade. The gun in his hands has the letters "DLS" carved into the stock.
95772-complete.title: Songblade Search

95810-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
95810-complete.text:
Ah, ye ventured all the way in and survived to tell the tale?! Let's have a look at what ye carry there. 

Well, knowing what ye went through to bring it back to me, I think it warrants a certain reverence for your artifact.
95810-complete.title: Lost Relic Carry

96339-complete.name: Innkeeper Wiley
96339-complete.text:
Wait, wait, you said your name was $N?

$N! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!

Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.

What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!
96339-complete.title: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle

96391-accept.name: Unknown
96391-accept.text:
The map you are holding seems to show a complex series of underground tunnels and highways that all seem to converge on a point underneath Ironforge itself.

You can't be sure what the runes say as they are written in the ugly jagged rune language of the Dark Iron dwarves, but you can guess at the purpose of these tunnels. As you are reading the map, a gust of wind washes over you and you can faintly hear a dwarven voice carried on it. Earthseer Farsen needs to see this.
96391-accept.title: Underground Map

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

97263-accept.name: Unknown
97263-accept.text: <Several misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent.">
97263-accept.title: Your Package Has Arrived

97894-accept.name: Borgus Steelhand
97894-accept.text:
Pleasure to make yer acquaintance! Name's Borgus, of the one and only Steelhand family. You can always count on a Steelhand fer a fair deal!

A few weeks back me brother Gorbold joined up with a merchant stall in Auberdine. Plenty of coin to be made supplyin' ships there, let me tell you! Lucky sod.

I haven't heard from him since--mind checking on him if yer heading that way?

There's a new ship in the harbor that will take ye straight there. Head to the southern-most dock; can't miss it!
97894-accept.title: Business in Auberdine

97894-complete.name: Gorbold Steelhand
97894-complete.text:
Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.

We could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.
97894-complete.title: Business in Auberdine

97914-complete.name: Baros Alexston
97914-complete.text: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>
97914-complete.title: Expanding Horizons

98025-accept.name: Unknown
98025-accept.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025-accept.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-complete.text:
It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her descent into madness.

Regardless, thank you for your service today, $c. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.
98025-complete.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings, $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98028-accept.name: Unknown
98028-accept.text:
All that remains of the powerful elemental is a globe of what seems to be pure water, clouded by some unknown substance. The edges of the sphere seem to be clear until you turn it--as if the cloud actively prevents you from peering within.

Whatever happened to it--and to the ruins it was guarding--is still active in some way.

Only Onu, the Ancient of Lore at the Grove of the Ancients to the far south, would have a chance at knowing more.
98028-accept.title: Baron Marinous

98028-complete.name: Onu
98028-complete.text:
<Onu appears surprised--or as surprised as an ancient can appear.>

Stairs descending in Mathystra? Could it be?

<Onu shakes his head.>

I must confer with the others on this. For now, know that it is good you uncovered this before the naga... or their cult allies.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts. It is no small feat to defeat an elemental guardian.
98028-complete.title: Baron Marinous

98028-progress.name: Onu
98028-progress.text: I can sense something far older than you in my presence, $r... what have you brought me?
98028-progress.title: Baron Marinous

98059-complete.name: Captain McManus
98059-complete.text:
Good work, soldier. I know you're not stationed with us, but we never turn away capable hands.

If they don't respond to THIS letter, we'll have to be more crude in our messaging.

We'll keep you on reserve for civilian interactions should the need arise again.
98059-complete.title: Hillsbrad's Hoard

98071-accept.name: Brewmeister Bilger
98071-accept.text:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
98071-accept.title: Brewer's Trade

98072-complete.name: James Halloran
98072-complete.text:
You're a real natural talent! Say, if you ever decide to take a break from the adventuring life, you come on back to your buddy James. I'll put you right to work!

Although, I suppose you'll be even older by then. Oh well!
98072-complete.title: Crocs of the Sky

98072-progress.name: James Halloran
98072-progress.text: Ah, $N! Do you have those scales?
98072-progress.title: Crocs of the Sky

98208-complete.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-complete.text:
It has survived! Oh, Elune be praised!

A thousand thanks, $N. If you are willing, I do have one more favor to ask of you...
98208-complete.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98208-progress.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98208-progress.text: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.
98208-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-accept.name: Sylessa Duskwhisper
98209-accept.text:
Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!
98209-accept.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
98209-complete.text:
The Nord'el survived? It cannot be... after all these years!

Our goddess is most wonderful indeed!

You have my thanks for delivering it here. It is a rare light in the dark times we have had of late, and a symbol of not only Elune's grace, but of the enduring will of our people to persevere without our immortality.

I will see to it that it is transported safely to Darnassus, so that it may be properly cultivated.
98209-complete.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98209-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
98209-progress.text: I welcome you to Auberdine, $c. How may we be of aid to you in your travels?
98209-progress.title: Bloom of the Heavens

98221-complete.name: Captain Stoutfist
98221-complete.text:
Ironforge as well? Nek'rosh certainly has his father's ambition!

What he lacks, of course, is the enslaved army of red drakes that proved so devastating in the war. He's made a gambit, alright--one he will pay for dearly.
98221-complete.title: From the Ashes

98247-accept.name: Unknown
98247-accept.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98247-accept.title: Shipping Label

98247-complete.name: Marcy Baker
98247-complete.text:
You have arrived at the right place! I am happy to mark you down as one of our affiliates. No contracts to sign and no commitments to weigh you down. All we ask of you is your diligence to assist in completing or returning any of our deliveries you find on your travels.

When you do so, you will be compensated with Merchant's Favor that will allow you to purchase goods and services we offer here. In fact, here's a little bit to get you started.

Now, do you happen to have the crate this came from?
98247-complete.title: Shipping Label

98247-progress.name: Marcy Baker
98247-progress.text: Ah, greetings! How can I be of assistance?
98247-progress.title: Shipping Label

98372-complete.name: Night Watch Guard
98372-complete.text:
The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.
98372-complete.title: An Unfortunate End

98815-complete.name: James Halloran
98815-complete.text:
These are some of the most impressive hides I've ever held; these will make spectacular detailing on all of my fine trim. Thank you, $N. 

Try these on and take one you'd like in trade.
98815-complete.title: Highland Hides

98815-progress.name: James Halloran
98815-progress.text: Welcome back, $c. Need any leather oil for your equipment?
98815-progress.title: Highland Hides

98824-complete.name: High Explorer Magellas
98824-complete.text:
What's this you've got...

Woah! Look at this marvel! The light through it dances like nothin' I've seen since my first dig in old Uldaman. The marks of the keepers on this cannot be mistaken.

You've done the League a great service bringin' this home. A find like this pushes the very boundaries o' the world's wisdom forward.

We'll be sure to record the details of your contribution! Truly a job well done, adventurer.
98824-complete.title: Prehistoric Prism

98824-progress.name: High Explorer Magellas
98824-progress.text: Have a look at our gallery, but please, don't touch the artifacts, unless it's one you're here to donate to the library.
98824-progress.title: Prehistoric Prism
